record.body:
## Rationale

The drill-down starts at the product. A card for each area gives the product layer a place to live, and it keeps the effort Home one step down, where its detail belongs. The effort Home moves to `#/effort/<name>`, so an effort now has a URL that can be shared and reloaded.

## Counter-argument

Keeping the effort Home as the landing page changes nothing for current users, who open the dashboard to see the live effort. A top-bar `Areas` link would add the product layer with no change to the default view. The product index makes the most common visit one click longer.

payload.alternatives: Keep the effort Home as the landing page with a top-bar Areas link
payload.choice: #/ shows the product index, one card for each area; the effort Home moves to #/effort/<name>
